dct_description_sm: The objectives of this study were to examine the impacts of active live yeast (S. cerevisiae) supplementation on DMI, feed sorting, gut permeability, ruminal and fecal pH and VFA concentrations, and fecal starch in cattle fed a high-grain finishing diet subjected to a ruminal acidosis challenge.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Saccharomyces cerevisiae Supplementation in Canadian Finishing Feedlot Diets: Chapter 5
